name: National MILO Marathon 2026 – Vermosa Leg
short_description: A half-marathon leg of the National MILO Marathon 2026 taking place October 11, 2026 in Vermosa, Cavite, Philippines.

faqs.question: When is the National MILO Marathon 2026 – Vermosa Leg?
faqs.answer: This race is scheduled to take place on October 11, 2026. It is held at Vermosa, a venue located across Imus and Dasmariñas in Cavite, Philippines, as part of the broader National MILO Marathon 2026 series of events.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The event offers five distance categories: 1km, 3km, 5km, 10km, and 21.1km. The 21.1km half-marathon is the primary distance for this leg, giving participants a range of options from short fun runs to a full half-marathon challenge.

faqs.question: Who organizes this race?
faqs.answer: The National MILO Marathon 2026 – Vermosa Leg is organized by RUNRIO Inc., which manages events under the long-standing MILO Marathon banner. This organizer is responsible for coordinating the race across its various legs, including the Vermosa location in Cavite.
